title: Stonewalling
question: How does stonewalling affect the other person?

paragraphs.text: Stonewalling means withdrawing from a conversation.
paragraphs.note: This defines stonewalling. The question asks how the other person is affected.

paragraphs.text: You go quiet, change the subject or leave the room.
paragraphs.note: This lists what you do. The question asks how the other person is affected.

paragraphs.text: It usually happens when you feel overwhelmed.
paragraphs.note: This says when stonewalling happens. The question asks about the other person.

paragraphs.text: The other person can't see that.
paragraphs.note: This says what the other person can't see. The question asks how they are affected.

paragraphs.text: They see you withdraw and feel ignored or rejected.
